title: Security Check — vet npm packages & MCP servers | Bouncer
excerpt: Paste an npm install command or MCP URL and get a readable verdict before you install: npm package security scanning for install scripts, credential access, malicious code, plus MCP server vetting for hidden prompt injection — with a pinned config.
content_html:
security check

Nobody reads what their agent installs. We do.

Your agent installs AI skills, MCP servers and npm packages on a single chat message. Paste what you're about to install and see exactly what it does before it ever runs on your machine.

Paste the install command you were about to run. We read the published files as text — we never run them.

Automated risk assessment. Not a guarantee of safety.
